findings.reason: diff.patch touches only classes/range.js lines 376/379. The test/fixtures entries for ^0.x (range-parse.js:56-61, range-include.js:95-104, range-exclude.js:69-70) all use default options, so none sets includePrerelease. Reverting the change would not fail any test.
findings.claim: The new caret lower bounds for 0.x ranges with includePrerelease are not covered by any added or existing test.
findings.evidence: diff.patch changes only classes/range.js (adding `${z}` at lines 376 and 379). No fixture in test/fixtures/range-parse.js, range-include.js or range-exclude.js combines a 0.x caret range without a prerelease (e.g. '^0.0.1', '^0.1.2') with `{ includePrerelease: true }`. The only caret fixtures with includePrerelease use major version 1 (range-include.js:116-119, range-exclude.js:82-84). acceptance.md points to story.md as the spec, but the packet has no story.md.

findings.reason: range.js:376/379 now append ${z}, but range.js:382-383 still emit `>=${M}.${m}.${p} <...` without it, so the asymmetry is real. Upstream node-semver has the same asymmetry, and the packet has no story.md, so the code can't settle whether it is intended.
findings.claim: With includePrerelease, '^0.1.2' now accepts 0.1.2-rc1 but '^1.2.3' still rejects 1.2.3-rc1, and nothing records that choice.
findings.evidence: Lines 376/379 now emit `>=${M}.${m}.${p}${z}` (z = '-0' when includePrerelease) for M === '0'. Line 382 still emits `>=${M}.${m}.${p} <${+M + 1}.0.0-0` with no `${z}`. test/fixtures/range-exclude.js:82 expects `['^1.0.0', '1.0.0-rc1', { includePrerelease: true }]` to be excluded, but nothing states the opposite rule for 0.x.
